President Murmu Flags Off Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela

President Droupadi Murmu hoisted a saffron flag at Ramkund in Nashik to mark the commencement of the Simhastha Kumbh Mela. Maharashtra Chief Minister Eknath Shinde participated in the rites at Trimbakeshwar. The event signifies the beginning of the Nashik-Trimbakeshwar Kumbh Mela.
